svg.text: As it is in the code: blocks, groups of ports, paints, cords, and ENGINE's signals.
A block in its kind's colour, its ports in their groups', a link in the colour of the port it leaves.
RACK · KINDS OF BLOCK ON EACH PAINT
A frame's band and outline in its kind's colour; the device's paint is who owns it.
A jack's ring on the rack, a port's dot in ENGINE.
Each device its own colour, a new one the least used; a cord in the colour of the device it leaves.
